description: A rounded antenna head split by a vertical line rises on a short stem from a small box atop a trapezoidal base with an arched doorway. Two curved radio-wave arcs radiate symmetrically on each side of the head.

A symmetrical control tower: a short antenna on a tapered cab, above a wider inverted-trapezoid observation deck crossed by two horizontal window bands. Two straight vertical legs support the deck from below.
A tall rounded-rectangle suitcase with a squared carry handle on top. Two parallel vertical ribs run down the front, and two short wheel stubs sit under the base.
A top-down airliner on a diagonal toward the upper right. A long narrow fuselage with a rounded nose carries two large swept wings mid-body and two small tail wings near the lower-left end.

concept: Person Running Out of Exit Door
description: A running figure in mid-stride faces left, arms pumping and one leg kicked back, beside an open doorway. The door frame is a tall right-angled outline on the right, open where the figure leaves it.
A side-view airplane climbs toward the upper right just above a runway. The runway is a wide trapezoid in perspective with a dashed centreline of four short marks.
An upright booklet with a slightly flared, uneven top edge showing the back cover behind it. A large globe with a curved meridian and an equator line fills the front cover.
An upright booklet with a slightly flared, uneven top edge showing the back cover behind it. A large globe with a curved meridian and an equator line fills the front cover.
A circle divided by a vertical line from top to bottom. Two diagonal strokes branch downward from the centre to the lower rim, forming the symmetrical inverted-fork peace sign.
A side-view airliner climbs toward the upper right with a long tapering fuselage. A swept tail fin rises at the left end, a far wing shows above, and a swept near wing hangs below mid-body.
A side-view airplane climbs gently toward the upper right with a rounded nose and a softly curved belly. It has a small upper wing, a swept lower wing, and a low tail fin at the left end.
A rounded rectangular information board. A down-right arrival arrow sits at the upper left and an up-right departure arrow at the upper right, above two rows of three short dashed text lines.
A landscape rounded-rectangle pass with three short horizontal detail lines stacked at the left edge. A side-view airplane climbing toward the upper right fills the rest of the card.
A landscape ticket with semicircular notches cut into both short sides. A vertical divider marks a stub on the left, and a small airplane climbing toward the upper right fills the main section.
A side-view airplane angled nose-up toward the upper right, with a swept tail at the left and a single swept wing below. A long horizontal ground line runs beneath it.
A side-view airplane climbs toward the upper right above a horizontal runway line. Its swept tail sits low at the left, with a far wing showing above the fuselage and a near wing below.
A side-view airplane faces right in level flight, with an angular tail fin, a swept upper wing and a swept lower wing. A small round wheel hangs on a short strut beneath the nose.

concept: Airplane Top View with Swept Wings
description: A symmetrical top-down airplane pointing straight up. A narrow rounded fuselage carries two swept wings with angular tips and a smaller pair of swept tail wings at the base.

concept: Airplane Top View with Rounded Wings
description: A symmetrical top-down airplane pointing straight up. A narrow fuselage carries two broad, gently swept wings with rounded tips and a small pair of rounded tail wings at the base.
A top-down airplane drawn as a single closed outline, pointing to the upper right. Broad wings with squared tips cross the fuselage near its middle, and squared tail wings sit at the lower left.
A top-down airplane drawn as a single closed outline, pointing to the upper right. Long swept wings with angled, pointed tips cross mid-body, and smaller pointed tail wings sit at the lower left.
A person with a round head stands behind a fence, forearms resting along its top rail. Two vertical posts frame three horizontal rails, and the legs show as a narrow inverted V below.

concept: People in a Boat on Waves
description: Two adults flank a smaller child, all shown as rounded head-and-shoulder figures seated in a shallow curved boat. A wavy water line runs along the hull bottom and extends to either side.
Two stick-like walking figures in mid-stride, facing right, one slightly behind the other. Each has a round head and a bent arm; the rear figure reaches toward the front one.
A security officer in a peaked cap and V-collar shirt stands behind a horizontal counter line. At the left, a small round device with a vertical slot sits on a thin post on the counter.
A security officer in a peaked cap and V-collar shirt reaches down to the left toward a boxy bag with a short loop handle. The bag stands beside the officer's arm, at waist height.
A security officer in a peaked cap and V-collar shirt extends an arm to the upper left. An open, upright passport or document booklet rises from the raised hand.
A person silhouette with a round head and outstretched arms stands inside an arched walk-through frame with a small cap on top. Three short alert dashes radiate from each side of the frame.
A head-and-torso security officer in a peaked cap with a brim. A V-collar sits at the neck, and one arm bends up and across the body toward the lower left.
A winding S-shaped dashed route links a small start circle at the upper left to an end circle at the lower right. A cross mark sits in the middle of the path, in the central bend.
A post with two arrow-shaped direction boards, one pointing right on top and one pointing left below, stands on top of a globe. The globe shows as a hemisphere with curved continent outlines.
